passage.title: Teacher-written memoir extract for the Year 7 end-of-year test (TGA)
paras: For thirty-one years, my grandfather kept the light on Carrick Point. Every evening at dusk he climbed all ninety-nine steps, ill or well, to light the lamp and wind the clockwork that turned it. He polished the great lens until it shone like water, and he wrote the weather in his logbook in small, neat letters. One winter the sea had teeth that night: waves broke over the gallery and the tower hummed like a struck bell. He did not sleep. In the morning a fishing boat limped into harbour, and its skipper climbed the cliff path just to shake his hand. My grandfather only said, "It was the light, not me."
